## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm run check`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] Manual browser verification, when relevant

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] README, runtime notes, or other documentation updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Browser, device, model-loading, search, scrape, or crawl impact considered
- [ ] No breaking change, or breaking change is described below

## Privacy and security

- [ ] The change preserves browser-only model inference
- [ ] No credentials, private notes, model binaries, logs, or generated output are committed
- [ ] Any security impact is described below

## Additional context

Add screenshots, logs with sensitive values removed, or implementation notes when they help reviewers.
